Subject: Merlot Supply — vendor onboarding: remittance schema & ACH proof

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for payouts — excited to get Merlot live. To finish our finance onboarding we need two quick things from you so we can (1) push the initial test ACH and (2) confirm remittance mapping for PO-driven invoices: 

1) Completed vendor onboarding form (attached). Please fill account holder name exactly as your bank records and include the bank letter if available.
2) A sample remittance file or a short spec for how you want PO & invoice references encoded (CSV or structured text). Our accounting team maps PO numbers from the "Remittance Detail" field and can adapt if you have a custom delimiter.

Two small asks / notes:
- We will send two microdeposits (USD) to the account once we receive the signed form and bank letter. Please confirm once you see them — amounts will be under $0.50.
- For POs, our default expected remittance string is: PO:{PO_NUM}|INV:{INV_NUM}. If you prefer a different layout (e.g., separate CSV columns), attach an example.

Attaching: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (please sign & return).

If you want to hop on a 15-min call to walk through the format, Marissa and I are available Mon/Tue morning.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

Elena — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and the sample CSV.

Karthik / Marissa: I uploaded Merlot's onboarding form and bank letter into the finance intake queue and kicked off the ACH test. Expect two microdeposits today or tomorrow. When the deposits post, Elena please reply with the exact amounts so we can validate and flip the live flag.

On the remit mapping side, our engineers reviewed the sample CSV and can map PO_NUMBER > remit.po and INVOICE_NUMBER > remit.invoice. Two configuration notes: 
- If Merlot ever includes multiple POs on a single invoice, we will keep the first PO as the primary PO mapping and attach the raw CSV to the invoice record.
- We support an alternate structured-delimiter format if you prefer: PO:12345|INV:67890 — but CSV is totally fine.

Next steps checklist:
- Jordan: Confirm microdeposit amounts when Elena reports them.
- Karthik: Configure remittance mapping in the vendor profile (map columns).
- Marissa: Create the Master Vendor record and set payment preference to ACH after verification.

Thanks team — sending the ACH now.

Jordan
Senior Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
